title: Import Test — Blistered Grip
description: The heat took the skin of your hand. Closing your fingers around anything is a decision you have to make on purpose.
treatment: Any healing that closes a burn, or an hour and a bandage.
gmnotes: Sibling fixture. Its only job is to be the SECOND page in the Fire journal, so a re-import of Scorched Sight can be checked for leaving it alone. Deliberately a different severity, a single modifier, statuseffect none and a flavor string, so it is unmistakable on the sheet and exercises the flavour path that Scorched Sight does not.
